title: GPU 占空比 + 闭环温控

standard.summary: 在训练步骤之间插入 GPU 空闲时间（占空比 < 1.0），或通过闭环温度控制自动调整占空比，精确控制 GPU 温度。
standard.effect: gpu_duty_cycle=0.8 表示每步后 GPU 空闲 20% 的时间。gpu_target_temp_c > 0 时启用闭环温控——自动调整占空比使 GPU 温度稳定在目标值。gpu_lock_clocks_mhz 锁定 GPU 核心时钟上限（需要管理员权限）。
standard.whenToUse: 长时间训练且 GPU 温度过高时。比固定 cooldown 更精细的温度控制。
standard.avoidWhen: 不需要温控时。占空比 < 1.0 会降低训练速度。

standard_en.summary: Inserts GPU idle time between training steps (a duty cycle below 1.0), or adjusts the duty cycle automatically through closed-loop temperature control, holding the GPU at a precise temperature.
standard_en.effect: gpu_duty_cycle=0.8 leaves the GPU idle for 20% of the time after each step. With gpu_target_temp_c > 0, closed-loop control kicks in and adjusts the duty cycle to hold the GPU at the target. gpu_lock_clocks_mhz caps the GPU core clock (which needs administrator rights).
standard_en.whenToUse: During long runs where the GPU gets too hot. Finer control than a fixed cooldown.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When temperature control is unnecessary. A duty cycle below 1.0 slows training down.

advanced.principle: gpu_duty_cycle < 1.0 时，每个训练步骤后插入 sleep((1-duty_cycle) * step_time) 的空闲时间。闭环控制：每步读取 GPU 温度传感器，如果温度 > target_temp_c 则降低占空比，如果温度 < target_temp_c 则增加占空比。gpu_lock_clocks_mhz 通过 nvidia-smi -lgc 限制核心频率上限（减少功耗和发热，但需要管理员权限）。
advanced.intervention: 训练循环中每步后根据占空比/温度插入 sleep。
advanced.expectedImpact: 精确控制 GPU 温度在安全范围内。
advanced.tradeoffs: 占空比 < 1.0 直接降低训练速度。闭环控制比固定占空比更智能但需要 GPU 温度传感器支持。

advanced_en.principle: With gpu_duty_cycle < 1.0, each training step is followed by sleep((1-duty_cycle) * step_time) of idle. Closed-loop control: reads the GPU temperature sensor each step — if temperature > target_temp_c, lower the duty cycle; if < target_temp_c, raise it. gpu_lock_clocks_mhz caps core frequency via nvidia-smi -lgc (less power and heat; needs admin rights).
advanced_en.intervention: The training loop inserts sleep per step based on duty cycle/temperature.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Precisely keeps GPU temperature within a safe range.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Duty cycle < 1.0 directly lowers training speed. Closed-loop control is smarter than a fixed duty cycle but needs GPU temperature-sensor support.
